title: Design System: rl-datagen — Trajectory evidence viewer

display.purpose: The page title only; once per page. 21px/650, -0.015em.

body.purpose: All prose at 13.5px/1.55, antialiased, tabular-nums globally; table cells and transcript text 13px; measures clamp 66–84ch. Key counts emphasized as bold digits (the Bold-Figure Rule).

label.purpose: Table headers (11.5px/500, faint, sentence case) and margin speaker labels (11.5px/550, faint, right-aligned) with 10.5px timestamps. No small caps, no italics anywhere.

mono.purpose: Confined to code, tool-call signatures, pre output, and .path file citations (11–12px).

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: #content fades up 4px on each navigation, restarted per render; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Evidence Table with Caption and Note
components.description: The primary component: caption above, faint sentence-case header row, three 1px horizontal rules, typeset verdicts, dagger + note for qualification.

components.css: .ds-tcap { font: 13px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5158); margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-tcap b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-tab { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(22,24,29,0.55)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(22,24,29,0.55)); font: 13px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-tab th { text-align: left; font-weight: 500; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--faint, #676c73); padding: 8px 16px 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(22,24,29,0.14)); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab td { padding: 6px 16px 6px 0; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab th.ds-n, .ds-tab td.ds-n { text-align: right; } .ds-click { cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--wash, rgba(22,24,29,0.035)); } .ds-click:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-yes { color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-no { color: var(--red, #b42318); } .ds-dag { font-size: 0.85em; vertical-align: super; line-height: 0; } .ds-tnote { font: 12px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--faint, #676c73); margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Three unnumbered text tabs on a hairline baseline; the active tab is weight 600 ink with a 2px ink underline.
components.html: RunsShipped-task runsSweep evidence
components.css: .ds-tabs { font: 13.5px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(22,24,29,0.14)); } .ds-tabitem { display: inline-block; margin-right: 24px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 2px 0 7px; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5158); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tabitem.ds-on { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #16181d); border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-tabitem:hover { color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-tabitem:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Line
components.description: Search and select as underline-only blanks, radius 0, with the running count flush right in faint ink.
components.html: 14 shown
components.css: .ds-filterline { display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 12.5px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5158); } .ds-blank { font: inherit; color: var(--ink, #16181d); background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(22,24,29,0.14)); border-radius: 0; padding: 1px 2px; } .ds-blank:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #16181d); outline: none; } .ds-blank:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-filterline input[type=search] { min-width: 200px; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint, #676c73); }

components.name: Cross-reference Link
components.description: Ink-colored text with a hairline underline that darkens to ink on hover; identical for anchors and .xref spans.
components.css: .ds-xref { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(22,24,29,0.14)); font: 12.5px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-xref:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-xref:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Transcript Turn
components.description: Signature component: quiet 11.5px/550 faint margin speaker with a 10.5px timestamp, pre-wrapped 13px body text, wash rule between turns; failing speaker turns signal red at 650.

components.css: .ds-turn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 132px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 0 20px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wash, rgba(22,24,29,0.06)); font: 13px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-spk { color: var(--faint, #676c73); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 550; text-align: right; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-spk .ds-t { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--faint, #676c73); } .ds-txt { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-fail .ds-spk { color: var(--red, #b42318); font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Colophon Text Action
components.description: The header's only actions — "open files" and "theme" — as plain text with hairline underlines, separated by a faint middle dot. No folder connection exists; the embedded snapshot plus drop/pick is the whole loading model.
components.css: .ds-colophon { font: 12.5px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5158); margin: 0; } .ds-act { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(22,24,29,0.14)); border-radius: 0; } .ds-act:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #16181d); color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-act:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sep { color: var(--faint, #676c73); padding: 0 7px; }

components.name: Path Citation
components.description: The page's citation device: a faint 11.5px mono file path under any datum drawn from a file.
components.css: .ds-path { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--faint, #676c73); word-break: break-all; margin: 3px 0 0; }

components.name: Lede with Bold Figures
components.description: Summary sentences carry key counts as weight-600 ink digits inside secondary-ink prose (the Bold-Figure Rule); never color, never spelled out.
components.html: 8 judged episodes across 3 scenarios; failures cite their transcripts below.
components.css: .ds-lede { font: 13.5px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5158); max-width: 78ch; margin: 0; } .ds-lede b { color: var(--ink, #16181d); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: This surface presents run trajectories the way a report presents results: numbered tables with captions above them, daggers and table notes for qualifications, a contents line of three sections, and file citations under every claim. The observability-console arrangement — cards, chips, stat tiles, colored lanes — is refused entirely. The material is white ground and cool ink, set in the system's modern sans; monospace is confined to code, tool-call signatures, and file paths. There is exactly one accent, signal red, spent only on failure and fault. Depth is flat; structure comes from hairline rules. Motion is a single authored moment: each navigation settles into place. Provenance: the concept-seed scripts could not run (no Node.js); the hand was dealt by hand, disclosed, and the user chose the proceedings/evidence direction explicitly. On 2026-07-28 the user redirected the rendition ("modern text, modern feel, no folder-connect step"): the evidence-page structure, accent discipline, and no-chrome refusal carried over; the bookish serif, small caps, italic headers, spelled-out numbers, and the File System Access folder connection were retired.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ink-on-white with a single failure accent, both themes first-class
Hairline table grammar: 1px rules top, bottom, and under the header; nothing vertical
Captions above tables ("Table N: …"), dagger + note for qualification
One modern sans for everything; monospace confined to code, calls, and paths
Flat, radius-free, shadow-free; one 0.22 s settle motion
Everything keyboard-reachable with one shared focus outline
Zero-click data: the snapshot is embedded in the file itself

rules.name: The Signal Red Rule
rules.body: Red is spent only on failure and fault. If a thing is not wrong, it is ink.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Tables carry exactly three 1px rules: rule-strength top and bottom, hairline under the header row. No vertical rules, no cell borders, no zebra striping, no boxes.

rules.name: The Confined Monospace Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only in code, tool-call signatures, and file paths. Prose, labels, numbers, and verdicts are sans.

rules.name: The Bold-Figure Rule
rules.body: Key counts in prose are digits emphasized with weight (8 judged episodes), never color, never spelled out.

rules.name: The No-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this page is a tile, card, chip, badge, or lane. If information needs grouping, it gets a rule or a caption, not a box.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: The settle is the only motion in the system. New interactions get state changes (underline darkening, wash hover), not animation.

dos: Do set all text in the system sans at 13.5px/1.55 with tabular-nums; clamp reading measures to 66–84ch.

Do give every new table the evidence treatment: caption above ("Table N: …"), faint 11.5px header row, three 1px horizontal rules, right-aligned numeric columns, and a .tnote + dagger for qualifications.
Do cite sources: any datum drawn from a file carries a faint 11.5px mono .path line.
Do style new inputs as blanks — transparent, hairline underline, radius 0, darkening to ink on focus.
Do make every interactive element focusable with the shared outline and Enter/Space-actionable; preserve Escape/back scroll restoration.
Do define both light and dark values for any new color, keyed off the existing ink/paper tints.
donts: Don't introduce cards, chips, stat tiles, badges, colored lanes, or any boxed grouping — the surface's founding refusal.
Don't spend red on anything but failure and fault.
Don't use border-radius, box-shadow, vertical table rules, zebra striping, or background panels anywhere.
Don't set prose, labels, or numbers in monospace; it is reserved for code, call signatures, and paths.
Don't add motion beyond the single settle, or bypass its reduced-motion guard.
Don't reintroduce permission-gated data sources; the embedded snapshot (plus drop/pick) is the whole loading model.
